text:
emma: Heads-up from Helios: they'd like a joint perf/W benchmark next Tue on their patched kernel. Scope: Redwood runtime vs Helios-tuned kernel on 8x A100-80GB. They care about tokens/joule and stable p99 for chat workloads. Can we run?

rick: We can. Need exact kernel commit from Helios, CUDA/driver, and BMC access. Also propose power caps 220W, 280W, and unrestricted.

yu: I'll handle infra + energy telemetry. Plan to combine IPMI watt readings with NVML per-GPU telemetry at 1s sampling and sync via monotonic clock.

ananya: Product/marketing want: tok/s (mean + 99% CI), tok/joule, p95/p99, and a small output-quality check. Also we need a draft marketplace blurb and callouts for any kernel tradeoffs.

tom: Helios (tom) here. We will provide kernel commit: helios/kernel@a1b2c3d4 and a diff. We patched scheduler and added a fused memcpy path. We'll also run our internal tuned build of CUDA kernels. BMC + root access ok for the window.

yu: Two-phase runs: cold (empty KV), warm (prefill 2k tokens). Batch profiles: chat mix [1,2,4] and completion [8,16]. We'll repeat each config 6 times to estimate CI.

emma: Good. Legal flagged claims: no absolute percentage claims without cross-check. @legal-bot please pre-approve phrasing for marketplace blurb.

legal-bot: Noted. Provide raw CSV and CI methodology. Avoid "X% faster" as headline until we validate with three independent runs.

rick: Bench harness will output CSV with: run_id, partner, model, build_tag, batch_size, seq_len, phase, tokens, seconds, joules, tok_per_joule, tok_per_sec, p95_ms, p99_ms, ci_tok_per_sec, notes. We'll also snapshot perf counters: sm_eff, dram_util, l2_hit, fc_util.

bench-bot: Planned -> run_id=helios-2026-03-31-a ; command: 
```
bench run --target a100-8x --model redwood-7b --profile chat:[1,2,4],completion:[8,16] \\--warmup 300 --repeats 6 --power-caps 220,280,0 \\--energy-sources ipmi,nvml --collect-counters sm_eff,dram_util,l2_hit,fc_util --report csv --eval sanity-50
```

tom: We'll also provide our tuned kernel build tag=helios-tune-v2 and container with LD_PRELOAD=/opt/helios/tune.so. Expect some micro-ops changes; we'll coordinate validation.

yu: Kernel/driver baseline: Ubuntu 22.04, CUDA 12.2, driver 535.xx, cuDNN 9.x. Please confirm exact versions on Helios host.

emma: I'll sync with Helios to confirm and schedule the announcement cadence. Marketing wants preliminary table within 48h and a joint tech note within 2 weeks.

ananya: Add an eval step: 50 sanity prompts + 10 adversarial checks. Fail if semantic similarity delta >0.7% or perplexity delta >1%. We'll include a short section in the tech note describing the tuning changes.

rick: Acknowledged. Lab slot requested: 2026-03-31 08:00-14:00 UTC. Please ack to lock.

emma: Ack. @tom please confirm Helios engineers will attend the run window.

tom: Helios will be on-call for the window. I'll DM the exact contact.

bench-bot: run_id=helios-2026-03-31-a queued by emma at 1752600305.

emma: Great progress. Team, add any missing metrics or legal flags by EOD so I can finalize the run plan and loop in Helios formally. :thumbsup:

yu: Adding CI bootstrap script for tok/sec and CSV exporter now.

ananya: I'll draft the marketplace blurb template and share in #marketing.

legal-bot: Also ensure we store raw logs + outputs for 90 days for audit.

emma: Noted. Thanks all.
